analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in all the patients who received either tocilizumab or placebo; patients were grouped according to the actual agent received.

follow_up.span: Table 3 Adverse Events through Day 60 in the Safety Population.

entry_age.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

notes: Entry criteria describe a subset within the question's population. Served SAE counts use the safety population by actual treatment received, so the mITT label is incorrect. SAE follow-up is through day 60; this is not the question's 28-day all-cause mortality endpoint.
